<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Fuaran.Core.Lease</id>
    <version>0.21.0</version>
    <authors>Andrew J. Willshire</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Fuaran-Core/fuaran-core</projectUrl>
    <description>Fuaran.Core.Lease — a generic lease/claim strand: claims over an abstract resource axis (Claim / Release / Expire) with a total apply / canApply where a conflicting claim is a typed rejection enumerating the current holder and the overlapping resources, a canonical wire codec, and a Fuaran.Core.OpStream StreamWitness — so lease history is an append-only, hash-chained, replayable, tamper-evident stream. The resource axis reuses Fuaran.Core.Tree's IdWitness (no new witness shape); expiry takes time as data (the host supplies "now"; Core reads no clock), so replay is deterministic. Generalises the coordination a multi-agent dispatcher hand-rolls. FSharp.Core only, Fable-clean.</description>
    <copyright>Copyright 2026 Diametrical Ltd</copyright>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Fuaran-Core/fuaran-core" commit="9ce7621ecfb27974f67f9398d7170fdb20bbe23c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Fuaran.Core.OpStream" version="0.21.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Fuaran.Core.Tree" version="0.21.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Fuaran.Core.Wire" version="0.21.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="FSharp.Core" version="10.1.300" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
